{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Chewie_SWSB.png|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca wearing a bandolier]]
A '''bandolier''' was a medium to large item of utilitarian clothing that the owner could wear around their left or right shoulder down across their torso, or as a large belt. Normally worn by military or paramilitary forces as well as mercenaries and others who needed large supplies of ammunition, bandoliers consisted of many ammunition pouches sewn together or snapped to a belt. Though typically used to carry extra ammunition for [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-type and other ranged weaponry, bandoliers could also carry grenades, supplies of [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]], and other sorts of items useful on the battlefield or in covert operations. They were also sometimes called "[[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]]" for this same reason.

[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] often wore bandoliers to carry supplies and ammunition for their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]]. Among the equipment stored in the bandoliers were [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]], canisters of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]], and ammunition cartridges carrying six [[Quarrel/Legends|quarrels]] each.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Amongst notable wearers of bandoliers were [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] including [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Jek/Legends|Jek]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Alderaanian]] soldiers including [[General]] [[Gesselle Organa]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Balic Cormac]], [[Galactic Republic]] [[Republic trooper|troopers]] including members of the [[Havoc Squad]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] soldiers including [[Admiral]] [[Fraabaal]] and [[Commander]] [[Lanklyn|Lankyln]] as well as [[Major]]s [[Bessiker]] and [[Faradin]], [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] including [[Dracen]] and [[Graham]] as well as [[Valion Pyron|Pyron]], as well as members of the [[Krozurbian]] [[Krozurbian War Council|War Council]] and [[Tusken Raider]]s of Tatooine who often carries ammunition and currency as part of its contents.<ref name="SOR4">[[Droids (1995) 8|''Droids'' (1995) 8]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
As in the real world, this word appears to have two different spellings in the ''Star Wars'' universe: the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''A New Hope'' novelization]] and the [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] novel, among others, spell it ''bandolier'', while the [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]] and ''[[Scoundrels]]'', for example, spell it ''bandoleer''.
